# PEPSComputeState

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/PEPSComputeState`

```text
PEPSComputeState, version 0.01

Usage: PEPSComputeState [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --tensor-file : name of the file containing the eigenstate to be displayed
    --peps-name : name of the peps used to form the output file name
    -x, --Lx : size of the lattice in x direction (default value = 4)
    -y, --Ly : size of the lattice in y direction (only 2 or 4) (default value = 2)
    -z, --sz : sz value (default value = -10000)
    --block-tensor : compute the 2*2 blocked tensor (instead of computing the state)
    --cylinder : compute the state on a cylinder
    --left-vector : name of the file containing the left boundary vector (useful only in cylinder mode)
    --right-vector : name of the file containing the right boundary vector (useful only in cylinder mode)
    --hstring : add a horizontal string
    --vstring : add a vertical  string
    --theta : angle in the U(1) inserted on the string (default value = 0)
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
